name: community
description: Compatibility profile for the stock Screeps private server: screeps/backend-local (the `@screeps/backend` package that the `screeps` package and screeps-launcher run) without any mods. It selects exactly the official operations backend-local routes (`required`), documents why it does not provide the others (`excluded`), adds the private-server routes it serves that the official client uses only when `options.official` is false (`additions`), and records where its replies or semantics differ from the official contract (`adaptations`, `overrides`). Community mods compose on top of this profile as separate plugin contracts. Official schemas are reused unchanged unless an override with `x-profile-reason` says otherwise.

info.title: Screeps community server HTTP API
info.summary: Official Screeps World HTTP contract composed with the community (stock backend-local) profile
info.description: Operations the stock Screeps private server (screeps/backend-local without mods, default storage `@screeps/storage`) provides for the official web client and community tools. Composed from the official Screeps World contract and the community compatibility profile; each operation's `x-profile` states whether it is an unchanged official operation (`required`), an official operation with documented differences (`adapted`) or a private-server route (`addition`). One world is served: `shard` values are ignored and replies are never grouped by shard. Success bodies are `{ok: 1}` merged with the handler result; database writes therefore also carry the storage driver's result (`modified` or `inserted` counts) or the inserted document with its LokiJS `meta` and `$loki` fields. Logical failures arrive as `{error}` with HTTP 200, including uncaught handler exceptions (`TypeError: …`); never infer success from the status code. Stock backend-local has no password sign-in or registration: accounts come from `POST /api/auth/steam-ticket` or from mods.

servers.description: Stock Screeps private server; configure host and port for your deployment.

host.description: Private server hostname or IP address.

port.description: Private server HTTP port (`GAME_PORT`, 21025 by default).

transport.reason: When `SERVER_PASSWORD` is set, backend-local answers every request it handles after its static `/assets` directory and landing page, which covers its `/api` router and `/room-history`, with `{error: 'incorrect server password'}` unless `X-Server-Password` matches (lib/game/server.js); the official web client sends that header when `options.official` is false and a server password is configured.

LegacyUsername.description: Required with `X-Token`: backend-local authenticates through passport-token, which rejects a request without a username value (HTTP 401 `{error: 'unauthorized'}`) and does not read it otherwise. Send any non-empty value; the official web client sends the token. The `username` and `token` query or body fields are accepted instead of both headers.
LegacyUsername.x-profile-reason: backend-local's token strategy requires a username value next to the token.

ServerPassword.name: X-Server-Password
ServerPassword.description: Server password (`SERVER_PASSWORD` environment variable) of a password-protected private server, independent of player authentication. Required only when the host sets one; a missing or wrong value returns HTTP 200 `{error: 'incorrect server password'}`.
ServerPassword.x-profile-reason: Private-server protocol header: backend-local checks it when `SERVER_PASSWORD` is set, and the official client sends it only when `options.official` is false.

Shard.description: Accepted for official-client compatibility. backend-local serves one world and ignores this value.
Shard.x-profile-reason: Single world: official shard routing does not apply.

Token.description: Session token issued by backend-local (`POST /api/auth/steam-ticket`, the socket `auth ok` reply or a sign-in mod): 40 lowercase hex characters (HMAC-SHA1), stored for 60 seconds. Every successful authenticated request issues a new token in the `X-Token` response header; store the latest value. Missing, expired or unknown tokens answer HTTP 401 `{error: 'unauthorized'}`. Never send tokens to untrusted hosts or follow authenticated cross-host redirects.
Token.x-profile-reason: backend-local issues its own short-lived session tokens instead of screeps.com account tokens.
